# Examples

One folder per tested phone, each with a `debloat.txt` that was applied and lived with for a few days,
and a `phone.json` that `tools/probe.py` uses to suggest it. These are starting points: the assistant
still asks before applying any `[ask]` group. To add yours, see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
